features: Your Everyday Companion, Morning to Night: From the first news update in the morning to the last video call at night, the Lenovo Tab keeps up with your entire day — its dependable 4GB RAM ensures smooth multitasking across apps, while the dual Dolby Atmos speakers deliver clear, crisp audio for every conversation, show, and song that matters to you.

Everyday Viewing Made Better – The 10.1-inch WUXGA IPS display delivers crisp detail and wide viewing angles, making it ideal for online classes, browsing, streaming, and multitasking. With 400 nits brightness and vivid 72% NTSC colors, your content stays clear and vibrant throughout the day.

Efficient Performance for Daily Tasks – The MediaTek Helio G85 processor combines performance and efficiency to handle everyday apps, video streaming, browsing, and light gaming with ease. Paired with Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.3, it ensures reliable connectivity for work, study, and entertainment.

Reliable Multitasking with Expandable Storage – Featuring 4GB LPDDR4x RAM and 64GB eMMC 5.1 storage, this device is built for everyday entertainment, productivity, and browsing. With microSD support up to 1TB, you can easily carry more movies, photos, files, and apps wherever you go.

Dolby Atmos Sound with Practical Camera Setup – Experience clear and immersive audio through dual side speakers tuned with Dolby Atmos for movies, music, and streaming. The 5MP front camera supports smooth video chats, while the 8MP rear camera is perfect for capturing photos and scanning notes or documents.

Built for Everyday Browsing and Streaming – The integrated 5100mAh battery provides reliable all-day support for work, study, and entertainment. With up to 9.5 hours of YouTube streaming and 10.5 hours of Chrome browsing, you can stay productive and entertained longer.
Display: 25.65 cm (10.1 inch), 1920 x 1200 Resolution, WUXGA TFT LCD (IPS) 400 nits, with TUV Rheinland Low Blue Light certification
Clear Case with Built-in Kickstand inside the box
